cpu-fused.note: shipped path: detect_spans(fused=True), PyAV, no subprocess

nvdec-scale.note: NVDEC, downscale on the GPU before the PCIe crossing (§3.4's rule)
nvdec-scale.command: ffmpeg -v error -nostdin -hwaccel cuda -hwaccel_output_format cuda -c:v h264_cuvid -i /home/dev/vidtheque-preview-data/media/1lgFGaHoGq8.mp4 -vf scale_cuda=256:144:interp_algo=bilinear,hwdownload,format=nv12 -pix_fmt bgr24 -f rawvideo -

nvdec-resize.note: NVDEC with the resize inside the decoder, no scale filter at all
nvdec-resize.command: ffmpeg -v error -nostdin -hwaccel cuda -hwaccel_output_format cuda -c:v h264_cuvid -resize 256x144 -i /home/dev/vidtheque-preview-data/media/1lgFGaHoGq8.mp4 -vf hwdownload,format=nv12 -pix_fmt bgr24 -f rawvideo -

cpu-pipe.note: control: same pipe, same detector, CPU decode — isolates NVDEC from the subprocess architecture
